children: Hackett Group reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $69.8 million, down 4.5% from $73.1 million a year earlier, while net income rose 39.6% to $3.6 million and diluted EPS increased to $0.14 from $0.09.
Revenue was $69.8M, compared with $73.1M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change (4.5%).
Net income was $3.6M, compared with $2.5M in the prior-year quarter; YoY change 39.6%.
Diluted EPS was $0.14, compared with $0.09 in the prior-year quarter.
Nine-month revenue declined 10% to $207.9 million, as growth in SAP was outweighed by decreases in Global S&BT and Oracle.

Global S&BT revenue fell amid prolonged client decision-making and questions about returns on AI initiatives. SAP revenue rose to $50.7 million for the nine months, supported by software sales and implementation work tied to S/4HANA Cloud migrations.
Hackett is extending its AI XPLR, XT and AIX platforms across transformation and software implementation services. AIX is beginning to support Oracle sales and delivery productivity.
Generative AI delivery platforms helped reduce headcount and personnel costs, while restructuring continued to align staffing with demand.
